items.title: CVE-2026-134791
items.description:
Since Symfony 7.2, expressions can contain comments. The lexer used a regular expression to find the end of a comment. When a /* was never closed, this regular expression scanned the rest of the expression, and the lexer then went on with the next character. So each /* scanned the rest of the expression again. Linting 192 KB of /*  took 9 to 11 seconds, and 96 KB took 34 seconds without PCRE JIT.

The lexer runs before the parser and its nesting limit. Any code that lints or parses untrusted expressions is affected, including the ExpressionSyntax validation constraint. A Length constraint on the same value doesn't help, since the validator runs both constraints.

The lexer now uses strpos() to find the end of a comment, and a comment that is never closed throws a SyntaxError. Such expressions were already invalid. Lexing takes linear time again.

items.title: CVE-2026-134790

The fix for CVE-2017-16652 restricts the redirects of HttpUtils::createRedirectResponse() to the host of the request. When framework.session.cookie_domain is set, it also allows the subdomains of that domain. To check a target, it read the host of the URL up to the first "/". But browsers also end the host at "\", "?" and "#". So with the cookie domain .example.com, a target like https://evil.test?.example.com passed the check, and the browser went to evil.test.

Applications are exposed when framework.session.cookie_domain is set. The default success and failure handlers of form_login redirect to the _target_path or _failure_path of the request. A login link can then send the user to another site right after a successful login, for example to ask for the password again.

HttpUtils now ends the host of a target where browsers do, before checking it against the allowed domains.

items.description:
The fix for CVE-2026-109449 made the expression parser check the nesting level of long expressions. This check exists since Symfony 5.4.54, 6.4.48, 7.4.21 and 8.1.9. The parser builds a ?: b with the node of a used twice, and the check walked every path to every node. Since Symfony 5.4, the access decision manager asked each voter once about all the attributes of a rule. RoleVoter grants access as soon as the user has one of the roles. So a user who had only one of these roles was granted access:

security:
    access_decision_manager:
        strategy: unanimous
    access_control:
- { path: ^/admin, roles: [ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_AUDITOR] }

Only attributes decided by the same voter were affected. For example, a role combined with allow_if still required both.

With the unanimous strategy, voters are asked about each attribute separately again, as before Symfony 5.4. Access is denied as soon as one of the attributes is denied.

items.title: CVE-2026-128856

items.title: CVE-2026-128838

items.description:

items.title: CVE-2026-132145
items.description: A flaw was found in rsyslog. When using the Datagram Transport Layer Security (DTLS) output module (omdtls) configured to authenticate receivers by name or fingerprint, the module validates the certificate chain against trusted certificate authorities but fails to verify that the certificate matches the intended receiver's identity or fingerprint. An attacker who can redirect or intercept outbound network traffic and present a certificate issued by a trusted certificate authority could capture forwarded log data, leading to information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-134650
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in useradmin/edit_user.cgi that displays home directory paths without HTML escaping to users with the autohome ACL. A Webmin user with broader Users and Groups rights can store a home path containing script via save_user.cgi, executing it in a restricted sub-administrator's Webmin session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134649
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in logrotate/force.cgi that prints logrotate -f diagnostic output without HTML escaping. Local OS users can create files with script-laden names in wildcard-rotated log directories, executing script in the Webmin session when Force Log Rotation is clicked.

items.title: CVE-2026-134648
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a header directive injection vulnerability in sendmail/autoreply.pl that allows unauthenticated mail senders to inject autoreply directives by placing them in inbound subject, from, date, or body fields. Attackers can inject Reply-Tracking to delete files at chosen paths, Autoreply-File to exfiltrate files readable by the delivery user, or arbitrary reply headers including To.

items.title: CVE-2026-134647
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability in web-lib-funcs.pl and fastrpc.cgi that sends cluster RPC traffic over raw TCP despite SSL configuration. Network-positioned attackers can read the session ID and remote_eval payloads or alter calls in transit to execute code as root on managed servers.

items.title: CVE-2026-134646
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability in the SMTP service monitor that never issues STARTTLS because get_smtp_status tests an undefined $ssl variable. Passive network attackers can capture AUTH PLAIN credentials sent in plaintext each time a STARTTLS-configured monitor runs, without needing a Webmin login.

items.title: CVE-2026-134645
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in proc/trace.cgi that allows local unprivileged OS users to inject markup via unescaped process arguments and system call parameters. Attackers can craft process command lines or file names passed to open so that script executes in a Webmin user's session when they trace the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134644
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a path traversal vulnerability in minecraft/minecraft-lib.pl that allows unauthenticated game players to overwrite arbitrary files as root via crafted chat messages. Attackers can send chat messages mimicking logged in lines so the root check_playtime_limits cron job rewrites attacker-chosen files, destroying their contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-134643
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in password_change.cgi that allows unauthenticated attackers to change passwords for accounts with empty stored hashes. When passwd_mode is 2, attackers can POST user, old, new1 and new2 with any old value to set a known password and gain access.

items.title: CVE-2026-134642
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in fastrpc.cgi that allows unauthenticated network peers to connect to tcpwrite and tcpread file-transfer listeners without session checks. Attackers can race to connect to the predictable transfer port during cluster operations to steal transferred files or replace staged packages, achieving root code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-134641
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in minecraft/save_backup.cgi that allows local attackers with write access to the Minecraft server directory to inject script via unescaped world directory names. Attackers can create a world directory containing HTML or script that executes in a Webmin user's session when they run Backup Now.

items.title: CVE-2026-134640
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in imap_login in mailboxes/folders-lib.pl that skips certificate verification and hostname checks for IMAP SSL connections. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate to capture IMAP credentials sent by the System and Server Status IMAP monitor and spoof monitor results.

items.title: CVE-2026-134639
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains an insecure default configuration in its Windows setup.bat script that provisions an administrator account with the credentials admin/admin and SSL disabled. Unauthenticated network attackers can log in over plain HTTP on port 10000 with these unchanged credentials to gain full Webmin administrative access.

items.title: CVE-2026-134638
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a missing integrity verification vulnerability in usermin/upgrade.cgi that downloads Usermin upgrade packages over plaintext HTTP without signature or digest checks. On-path network attackers or DNS spoofers can supply a malicious RPM, Debian, or tar.gz package whose maintainer scripts or setup.sh execute as root during upgrade.

items.title: CVE-2026-134637
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a STARTTLS downgrade vulnerability in send_mail in mailboxes/boxes-lib.pl that continues over plaintext when STARTTLS is rejected. Man-in-the-middle attackers can strip or reject STARTTLS to capture configured SMTP AUTH credentials, crackable CRAM-MD5 exchanges, and the content of sent mail.

items.title: CVE-2026-134636
items.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a weak randomness vulnerability that allows attackers to predict TOTP two-factor secrets generated by generate_base32_secret() using a time and PID seeded rand(). Attackers who know a user's password and estimate enrollment time can enumerate candidate seeds, reproduce the secret, and bypass the second authentication factor.
